retrieved_policy_sections:
## Skilled Nursing Follow-up

Required documentation for authorization:
- Signed physician order within 30 days of service
- Progress notes within 30 days of service
- Functional assessment if last assessment older than 60 days

Denial appeal basis:
- Missing documents: request specific missing items, then resubmit
- Medical necessity dispute: attach clinical notes with physician
  attestation before filing formal appeal
- Conflicting denial reasons: escalate to compliance review before acting

Approval threshold: all required documents present and dated correctly.

recommendation.draft_text:
Dear [Payer Name] Authorization Department,

We are writing regarding the authorization request submitted on behalf of [Patient Name] (Member ID: [XXXX]) for two skilled nursing follow-up visits as ordered by Dr. Chen.

Per your correspondence dated [Date], authorization has been approved and all required documentation has been received and verified. We are writing to confirm the approved authorization number and effective dates so that we may proceed with scheduling the medically necessary skilled nursing visits without delay.

Please provide the following at your earliest convenience:
1. Authorization number for the approved skilled nursing visits
2. Effective dates of the authorization
3. Any applicable billing or coordination instructions

The treating physician, Dr. Chen, has documented that these follow-up visits are medically necessary, and we are eager to ensure continuity of care for this patient.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. Please contact our office at [Phone Number] or [Email] with any questions or to provide the authorization details.

Sincerely,
[Provider Name]
[Provider NPI]
[Contact Information]
